system.description: Due to your bodies loose concept of stability, particles that would normally harm others, have a lessened effect on you. You gain a rank of mastery to saving throws made to resist effects that originate from a cloud, gas or smoke. This bonus also extends to jutsu or effects that have the Inhaled keyword. Beginning at 11th level, this instead becomes 2 ranks of Mastery.
